title: M5 – A Diverse Benchmark to Assess the Performance of Large Multimodal Models Across Multilingual and Multicultural Vision-Language Tasks
reasoning: The paper focuses on introducing a benchmark to evaluate Large Multimodal Models on vision-language tasks across 41 languages and diverse cultural contexts. While it discusses performance disparities between languages and cultures (linguistic/cultural bias), it does not include any components for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
